description: Types arceaux vélos is a dataset listed in Opendata de la Ville de Liège open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ville de Liège. Le jeu de données permet de visualiser les différents types d'arceaux destinés au stationnement des vélos sur le territoire de la Ville de Liège. Celui-ci recense uniquement les arceaux gérés par la Ville. Les informations sont régulièrement vérifiées par nos services sur le terrain. Coverage: Liège. The portal files it under Mobilité, Espace public. Its keywords are vélo, mobilité, stationnement. The portal shows 11 records. The portal shows 2021-11-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-liege-be-portal.
